reviewer: Codex root (AI-assisted supplied-English curation for 1 Samuel 13–18)
review_method: Read all 183 complete actual source units and every retained target passage and necessary context. Independently displayed and reread all 186 full source/target/category/rationale triples in six untruncated chunks. Preserved the initial author draft and recorded twenty exact old/new row refinements, including seven additional independent peer precisions and the agreed route-direction correction; then displayed and reread every complete corrected triple before freezing. Source numbering gaps and actual short readings remain intact. Local links describe particular commands/responses, narrated outcomes, repeated wording, object use, declared intentions or contrasts and claim no independent corroboration. This is an initial supplied-English curated pass, not exhaustive discovery or new original-language, apparatus, chronology, modern site, medical or independent human specialist verification.
pin_method: Fresh raw fetches of every retained source book at the fixed commit, rehashed as exact Git blobs against fixed-commit metadata; full parsed cache equality separately verified. Normalized cache bytes are not claimed identical to raw source bytes.
